thread:
elena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — leadership asked for concrete clarifications on release cadence, oncall handoffs, quality bars, and SLAs. Post your Qs and we'll answer. I'll start.
jon: For releases, what's the new canary window? Are we moving to 2-hour canary or keeping 24h?
elena: We will move to a 4-hour canary for low-risk patch releases, 24-hour for major changes. Canary policy: config lives in the release playbook.
priya: How do we classify 'low-risk' vs 'major'?
elena: Low-risk = hotfixes / config-only / perf tweaks that touch <2 services and pass staging e2e + rollback smoke. Major = model changes, infra migrations, DB schema migrations.
mark: Is there a required automation gate for release? e.g., must pass nightly regression and 98% e2e success?
elena: Yes — gating: CI green, staging E2E >=98% over the last 6 runs, SLO regression check (no regressions >2% on P0 evals). If gating fails, canary must be extended and a retro ticket created.
sam: Oncall — what's the handoff window between shifts?
elena: Handoff is 15 min overlap + a one-line async handoff doc posted in #eng-oncall. New policy: mandatory 30-min overlap for the first shift change when someone is new to rotation.
ashley: For Dedicated customers, any SLA changes we should be aware of?
elena: SLA tiers unchanged — Dedicated base tier stays at 99.9% monthly uptime; Enterprise negotiable up to 99.95% with reserved capacity. We still require runbook coverage and a validated failover path.
jon: Paging policy — will L2 be paged directly for perf regressions or still only L1?
elena: Perf regressions page L1 first. If incident affects >2 zones or >X qps or crosses error budget, L2 auto-escalation triggers. Thresholds are in the runbook: https://go/runbooks/release-cadence
priya: Simple ask — can we get a one-page checklist artifact for the release lead (pre/during/post)?
elena: Yes — new checklist will be added to the PR template and release-checklists repo by EOD Monday.
dev-bot: Reminder: release scheduled 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC for feature/fast-path.
jon: Thanks — can leadership confirm rollback window for hosted vs Dedicated?
elena: Rollback window: aim for automated rollback within 30m for hosted; for Dedicated (customer infra touch) target 2 hours and coordinate with customer ops.
sam: Can we schedule a monthly review for quality bars?
elena: Agreed — monthly quality-bar reviews will be added to Eng Ops calendar. First review next Wednesday.
priya: Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
